snippet.title: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under | Reveal Trailer [holo Indie]
snippet.description:
A vacation gone wrong?! Australia is in chaos! Its up to Bae to find her missing friends and save the country, in a new turn-based RPG by Studio PP and published by holo Indie!

Wishlist the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4682890

Twitter: https://x.com/StudioOuiOuiPP

#TeleBAE #BaelzBrush #BaeSplit #StudioPP
